analyst.text: New York have won five straight, but OG Anunoby (calf) and Jordan Clarkson are out and Karl-Anthony Towns (knee), Josh Hart (shoulder) and Miles McBride (adductor) are all questionable. Cleveland are still without Evan Mobley and can be eliminated from the NBA Cup with a loss, and they won the last meeting 115-107 behind 32 from James Harden. Cup desperation and the Knicks' thin injury list lean this one slightly Cleveland on the news angle.
